title: Chess AI
description: Play a game of chess against a smart artificial intelligence.
about:
Chess AI is a browser game where you select a piece, then select its destination square to play against the computer. Use the on-screen options to adjust the view or AI speed.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Select a piece, then select its destination square to play against the computer. Use the on-screen options to adjust the view or AI speed.

controls.action: Choose a piece and move square
Adjust the AI and board view

tips: Use click / tap to choose a piece and move square.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Chess AI?
faq.answer: Select a piece, then select its destination square to play against the computer. Use the on-screen options to adjust the view or AI speed.

faq.question: Can I play Chess AI in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
